camel_example: aliyun nlb AddServersToServerGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Servers.1.ServerType Ecs --Servers.1.Description ECS --Servers.1.ServerId 'i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --Servers.1.Port 443 --ServerGroupId 'sgp-atstuj3rtoptyui0000' --Servers.1.Weight 100 --Servers.1.ServerIp '192.168.6.6' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --method POST --force
description_en: Adds backend servers to a specified server group
description_zh: 向网络型负载均衡服务器组中添加后端服务器
kebab_example: aliyun nlb add-servers-to-server-group --server-group-id sgp-atstuj3rtoptyui0000 --servers ServerType=Ecs ServerId=i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 Description=ECS ServerIp=192.168.6.6 Port=443 Weight=100 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddServersToServerGroup

fields.help_en:
The description of the backend server.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at sings (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
fields.help_zh:
服务器描述信息。

长度限制为2-256个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、中文、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
fields.name: description

fields.help_en:
The port that is used by the backend server to provide services. Valid values: 0 to 65535. If you do not set this parameter, the default value 0 is used.

If multi-port forwarding is enabled, you do not need to set this parameter. The default value 0 is used. NLB forwards requests to the requested ports. To determine whether multi-port forwarding is enabled, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445895.html operation and check the value of the AnyPortEnabled parameter
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器使用的端口。端口范围0~65535，不填则默认传入端口值0。

当服务器组开启全端口转发后，添加后端服务器时无需指定端口（默认传入0），NLB将按照前端请求端口转发流量至后端服务器。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/445895.html接口返回的**AnyPortEnabled**字段查询是否开启了全端口转发
fields.name: port

fields.help_en:
The backend server ID.

If the server group is of the Instance type, set this parameter to the IDs of Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances, elastic network interfaces (ENIs), or elastic container instances.
If the server group is of the Ip type, set ServerId to IP addresses
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器ID。

当服务器组为Instance类型时，该参数为Ecs、Eni、Eci的资源ID。

当服务器组为Ip类型时，该参数为IP地址
fields.name: server_id

fields.help_en: The IP address of the backend server. If the server group type is Ip, set the ServerId parameter to IP addresses
fields.help_zh: 服务器IP地址。当服务器组为Ip类型时，必须指定IP地址
fields.name: server_ip

fields.help_en:
The type of the backend server. Valid values:

Ecs: the ECS instance
Eni: the ENI
Eci: the elastic container instance
Ip: the IP address
fields.help_zh:
后端服务器类型，取值：

Ecs：ECS实例。
Eni：ENI弹性网卡实例。
Eci：ECI弹性容器。
Ip：Ip地址
fields.name: server_type

fields.help_en: The weight of the backend server. Valid values: 0 to 100. Default value: 100. If this parameter is set to 0, no requests are forwarded to the server
fields.help_zh: 后端服务器的权重，取值范围：0~100。默认值为100。如果设置权重为0，则不会将请求转发给该后端服务器
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en:
The backend servers that you want to add.

You can add up to 200 backend servers in each call
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务器列表。

单次调用最多支持传入200个服务器
parameters.name: servers

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the NLB instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: validates the request without performing the operation. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the validation, the corresponding error message is returned. If the request passes the validation, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): validates the request and performs the operation. If the request passes the validation, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会添加服务器。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token. Ensure that the token is unique among different requests. Only ASCII characters are allowed.

If you do not set this parameter, the value of RequestId is used.**** The value of RequestId is different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
